propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incremental criterion verdicts banked, violating the documented incremental-banking contract.
Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently per model response, making prompt-only instructions insufficient to serialize evidence collection and commit actions before budget exhaustion.

An explicit completion-only wrapper policy must enforce one governed action per response, count evidence responses for the current unbanked criterion, and invoke a provisional met=false bank at the third response if still unbanked.

The finite-banking mechanism requires an authoritative system-level state machine (process manifest id in order, use prefetched evidence first, select one repository action per response, record via record_criterion_verdict, advance) decoupled from untrusted ticket context.

The original 9895-aa2c-8907-4db6 incident exhibited zero CriterionBank writes after 24 requests and 37 repository actions; the repair must restore normal evidence-backed PASS/FAIL rather than CompletionRecoveryError while maintaining incremental progress visibility.
